proposal_escalation.finding: Proposal preparation requires a recorded Operator escalation. Submission of the Operator-authored handoff prepares the CR-017 proposal.

review_escalation.finding: Plan and evidence review reject missing Operator escalation with OPERATOR_ESCALATION_REQUIRED; evidence escalation is bound to the exact evidence digest.

updated_helper.finding: The current investigate helper submits the explicit Operator escalation after completed analysis. The affected older helpers do not.

old_run_helper.finding: run_case returns completed analysis without submitting escalation; execute then assumes proposals[0] or directly reviews QE-004.

old_probe_helper.finding: wait_run waits for analysis/task completion only; confirm assumes a non-null action_id.

null_eligibility.finding: CR-019 grounded cards dereference v.eligibility.touchless_eligible and v.eligibility.checks without checking the initial None state.

invalid_output_handler.finding: The existing handler converts AttributeError/TypeError/ValidationError to CHAT_INVALID_OUTPUT with no fallback answer.

eval_abort.finding: The base variant catches its first exception, aborts the remaining base sequence, and missing observations become failed invariant results.

copy_expectation.finding: The test demands the exact substring evidence available; actual detail is Applicable workload evidence is available.

quality_escalation.finding: Program Owner review requires the exact recovery plan plus a previously recorded Operator submission_id and submitted_at.

follow_up: Fix the pre-investigation Concierge None-eligibility handling separately, and update the older test/eval setup flows to submit explicit Operator escalations while preserving all authority and intended assertions. No fixes, assertion weakening, or further reruns performed in this classification subtask.
